description: Calculate hypothetical daily revenue after an illustrative time/hashrate-based developer fee and electricity cost using user-supplied inputs. H*q*(hours/24)*(1-f/100) - (W/1000)*hours*t. This is a scenario, not a profit forecast or a statement of actual VNISH fees. Use pre-fee gross hashrate; do not deduct the fee twice.

dev_fee_percent.description: Scenario fee as a percent of gross daily revenue. This tool does not supply an actual firmware fee.

hashprice_usd_per_th_day.description: Gross daily revenue for one TH/s, USD/(TH/s)/day. Supply it yourself; no market data is fetched.

hashrate_th_s.description: Gross pre-fee hashrate, TH/s. The daily hashprice input must use the same hashrate basis.

operating_hours_per_day.description: Hours per day at the stated hashrate and wall power. Revenue and electricity scale by this same uptime assumption.

power_w.description: Average wall power while operating, watts.

name: calculate_roi_scenario
title: Calculate an ROI ASIC daily scenario
